description: Land Acquisition - Weragala, Narammala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Ambalanpitiya and Ward No. 12 Wehera, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Amendment to the Notice Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1995/11 of 29.11.2016 by D/S Division, Alawwa
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, uses, claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category. There is no government personnel information, organizational changes, or other specialized content that would override this classification.
